metadata.Pre-Requisite: Recommended to have knowledge of Discrete Maths and Introduction to Computing
metadata.Description: This course gives students an introduction to the evolution of Database Systems and a basic understanding of a Database Management System, devotes to the Relational Database Modeling, Design Theory for Relational Databases as well as various aspects of Relational Database Programming such as database query language, SQL, transactions, contraints, triggers, and stored procedure. During the course, students will have a chance to practice on a certain DMBS suitable to the concrete context of course implementation. Assessment structure: 1) On-going Assessment: - 05 Labs 15% (ABET k) - 02 progress tests: 10% (ABET b) - 01 Assignment: 20% (ABET b, i) - Practical exam (PE) 25% (ABET k) 2) Final Exam: 30% (ABET b) 3) Final Result 100% Completion Criteria: 1) Every on-going assessment component >0 2) Practical Exam >0 3) Final Exam Score >=4 & Final Result >=5
metadata.StudentTasks: - Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all assigned exercises/asignments given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://cms.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

sections.heading: Syllabus Details
rows: Recommended to have knowledge of Discrete Maths and Introduction to Computing

This course gives students an introduction to the evolution of Database Systems and a basic understanding of a Database Management System, devotes to the Relational Database Modeling, Design Theory for Relational Databases as well as various aspects of Relational Database Programming such as database query language, SQL, transactions, contraints, triggers, and stored procedure. During the course, students will have a chance to practice on a certain DMBS suitable to the concrete context of course implementation. Assessment structure: 1) On-going Assessment: - 05 Labs 15% (ABET k) - 02 progress tests: 10% (ABET b) - 01 Assignment: 20% (ABET b, i) - Practical exam (PE) 25% (ABET k) 2) Final Exam: 30% (ABET b) 3) Final Result 100% Completion Criteria: 1) Every on-going assessment component >0 2) Practical Exam >0 3) Final Exam Score >=4 & Final Result >=5

- Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all assigned exercises/asignments given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://cms.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

rows: Multiple choices Marked by Computer or a suitable format

guided by instructor, prepare at home present in class
